renderers.label: Scatter · 2D
renderers.description: Two numeric or date axes; optional marker channels and facets.

renderers.label: Time / line
renderers.description: Ordered series with explicit missing-value gaps.

renderers.label: Bars
renderers.description: One bar per observation, without implicit aggregation.

renderers.label: Scatter · 3D / 4+D
renderers.description: Three axes, orbit controls, time frames and optional color, size, alpha and panels.

renderers.label: Geographic markers
renderers.description: Longitude on X, latitude on Y. Coordinates must be explicitly provided, never inferred from a name.

methods.label: Descriptive statistics
methods.description: Valid/missing count, min, max, mean, median and sample SD.

methods.label: Pearson correlation
methods.description: Aligned pairs; excludes missing values explicitly. Correlation is not causation.

methods.label: Spearman rank correlation
methods.description: Aligned ranks with ties; no causal or route inference.

providerProfiles.label: Versioned source table
notices: Import and review a source mapping before showing it as evidence.

providerProfiles.label: Google Trends website export
notices: Relative interest is not a search count, prevalence or consumption.
Compare only observations in the same export normalization scope.
Interface language is not the language of searchers.
Trends does not measure sentiment or verify distribution routes.
A source export importer is available; live API access is not configured.

providerProfiles.label: Annotated context / sentiment corpus
notices: Record corpus, sampling and annotation/model method in the source description.
Model sentiment stays modeled; a reviewed estimate is not a direct observation.
